title: Dialer Pacing: Abandoned Calls, Predictive Dialing and Retries | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
Automatic dialing places calls for your agents, so it needs guardrails. A call is abandoned when a person answers and no agent joins within two seconds, and many rules limit how often that may happen. This video covers the abandoned-call settings of a dialer profile in the CrestApps Contact Center for Orchard Core, Predictive pacing, what the dialer does with every record, and how retries work.

In this video:
• Why abandoned calls matter
• The abandonment-rate cap and the abandoned-call message
• Predictive pacing: one call per reserved agent, or over-dial
• The checks the dialer runs before every call, and how a call that ends early is dispositioned
• Retries and the attempt limit
• Where pacing settings help
